description: This file defines the Ext.ux.ToolbarReorderer class, a plugin for Ext JS 3.2.1 that enables drag-and-drop reordering of toolbar items within an Ext.Toolbar instance.

classes.name: Ext.ux.ToolbarReorderer
classes.description: A plugin class that adds drag-and-drop reordering functionality to Ext.Toolbar instances.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, attaches event handlers to the toolbar, and calls the superclass init method.

methods.name: createItemDD
methods.description: Sets up a toolbar button as a draggable element, defining drag start, drag, and end behaviors.

methods.name: onMovedLeft
methods.description: Handles reordering when a button is moved left in the toolbar.

methods.name: onMovedRight
methods.description: Handles reordering when a button is moved right in the toolbar.

methods.name: updateButtonXCache
methods.description: Updates internal cache of button X positions for accurate drag calculations.
